cohort: The abstract discusses the occurrence and complications in patients experiencing cesarean scar ectopic pregnancies.
finding: The incidence of cesarean scar ectopic pregnancies is increasing due to more cesarean sections, necessitating early ultrasound detection to prevent severe complications like hemorrhage, uterine rupture, and maternal death.
mod_finding: The rising incidence of cesarean scar ectopic pregnancies is directly attributed to the increased number of cesarean section deliveries.
